---
title: "Table Comparison Diagnostic"
output: html_document
---

```{r compare}
library(sparklyr)
library(dplyr)
library(dbplyr)

sc <- spark_connect(method = "databricks")

# Phase 1 table — Argentina
p1 <- tbl(sc, in_catalog("projects", "xx_drought_index", "drought_index_dailysummary")) %>%
  filter(country == "Argentina") %>%
  summarise(
    source    = "phase1",
    n_rows    = n(),
    avg_precip = mean(precip, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_date  = min(time),
    max_date  = max(time)
  ) %>%
  collect()

# Global silver table — Argentina
global <- tbl(sc, in_catalog("era5-daily-data", "silver_dev",
  "aer_era5_silver_approximate_1950_to_present_dev_interpolation_res5")) %>%
  filter(country == "Argentina") %>%
  summarise(
    source     = "global",
    n_rows     = n(),
    avg_precip = mean(sum_tp_mm, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_date   = min(time),
    max_date   = max(time)
  ) %>%
  collect()

result <- rbind(p1, global)

# Also check Sri Lanka in global
lk <- tbl(sc, in_catalog("era5-daily-data", "silver_dev",
  "aer_era5_silver_approximate_1950_to_present_dev_interpolation_res5")) %>%
  filter(country %like% "%Lanka%") %>%
  summarise(
    source     = "global_lanka",
    n_rows     = n(),
    avg_precip = mean(sum_tp_mm, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  collect()

all_results <- list(argentina_compare = result, sri_lanka_check = lk)

out_path <- "/Volumes/projects/gwsc_drought/drought_outputs/diag_table_compare.rds"
saveRDS(all_results, out_path)

cat("Argentina comparison:\n")
print(result)
cat("\nSri Lanka check:\n")
print(lk)
cat(sprintf("\nResults saved to: %s\n", out_path))

spark_disconnect(sc)
```
